Starlink in Bolivia! ❤️🇧🇴

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Elon Musk megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Fireside Alpha (@firesidealpha); megjelent: 2026-10-24T14:51:49+00:00; link: https://x.com/firesidealpha/status/2114006956679799232; média: videó, 70 másodperc]
Bolivian President says Starlink will make information “open to everyone,” with a connection even “in the deepest ravine,” as 4,700 antennas go to schools nationwide

Rodrigo Paz (President): “…it’s the same kind of network we are building through this system of Starlink antennas, to create a network of information and communication and to decentralize the power that some hold when only a few keep the information. Now information will be open to everyone.”

“It’s more than 4,000 antennas, 4,700 antennas if I’m not mistaken, nationwide for every department, but especially for rural municipalities, because you don’t only need a road to communicate, you need information to make decisions...”

"...It doesn't matter where in the country you are, in the deepest ravine, you'll have a connection there. It's not one satellite, it's many satellites, thousands of satellites that are going to serve Bolivia."
